## Compute A'B

Constructs two 3-by-2 matrices and computes A'B directly, entry by entry, and as a sum of row outer products.

```{webr}
A = matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
B = matrix(c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
t(A) %*% B

# The same (1,2) entry as an inner product of two columns
sum(A[, 1] * B[, 2])
```
